summary: The prd storage release now creates backup-reader and its Secret backup-reader-credentials, and runs the s3-mirror CronJob (03:30, Forbid, 2 h activeDeadlineSeconds): prd-owned buckets found through the admin API are rclone-synced into a crypt remote at gdrive-pieter:Homelab Backups/s3-mirror, with current/ and archive/<stamp>/ and 30 archive folders kept per bucket; it is off by default and on only in prd values. 10 hermetic tests were added, kc project test is green, and P3/P5 in the plan carry the CronJob name, run bound, Secret names and crypt settings.
